title: Flight game model (point mass, angle-lag attitude)

implements.text: 3-D translation with semi-implicit Euler at a fixed 100 Hz; thrust from the calculator's static thrust; one isotropic drag law
Open-circuit curve (11 points per chemistry), internal resistance sag, low-voltage cut-off
Mean wind plus two sine terms of the step counter

mocked.text: Attitude is first-order lag toward the stick target; no inertia tensor, no rate loop

unsupported.text: Advance-ratio thrust loss, ground effect, per-axis drag

parameterSources.note: 'the original's 0.045 for a 5-inch'; tuned to feel right

validation.flavour: frameOf equal; raw state differs by 1 ulp from step 12

knownFailureCases: Faults are scripted rotations (900, 500, 400, 300 deg/s) not consequences of dynamics: see model:flight.faults-scripted@1, tier T0
Sphere-against-box collision may tunnel at 20 m/s (hypothesis)
Wing top speed overstated (static thrust used at speed)

performance.metric: us per stepSim, quad5 bando course
performance.label: MEASURED
